title: Production Recipe Core, Clean-Room Provenance & Provider Adapter Contract
objective: Create the common PCA production recipe/manifest contract with stable recipe identity/versioning, typed inputs/outputs, deterministic parameters and seeds, provider/tool identity, source hashes, rights/provenance, execution receipts, cache identity, local/provider modes, failure/retry semantics and ARI derivative registration while enforcing clean-room boundaries.

scope.purpose: Establish the common deterministic recipe/provenance/provider-adapter contract used by later PCA production tooling without becoming gameplay, World, Character, narrative, resource-rights or release authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative production recipes can be deterministically described, validated and receipted with explicit clean-room provenance/provider boundaries and ARI registration references, failing closed on invalid provenance/rights/provider inputs without creating canonical gameplay or release authority.

selection_boundaries: Validation Core transitioned from CNI to PCA at PCA-01 governed start and sealed CNI-13 merge d5237037d9bb68a8c76ca20b248e801d9973332f as the predecessor baseline; historical predecessor profiles remain inert.

PCM clean-room authority, ARI-02 resource identity, ARI-03 derivative lineage, ARI-11 rights/use capability and MIB-03 deterministic provenance/retry semantics remain external owner authorities composed by PCA-01 rather than replaced.
Provider descriptors remain reviewed non-executing plans; PCA-01 granted no credentials, network execution, procurement, paid-service, upload or data-sharing authority.
Production code was frozen after minimum GREEN bdfa75d818e6d07bc34088085f3163c58566d431. The later terminal repair changed only verifier text matching and did not alter production behavior.

ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after exact-tree publication. PCA-02 is enabled by completed PCA-01; although PCA-15 also becomes internally eligible, no cross-program rotation gate is newly satisfied and strict execution order selects PCA-02.
PCA-02 is selected_not_started only; no branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it. PCA-03+, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.

proof_repair.failure_signature: verifier expected object-property syntax for typed reason literal

next_action: PCA-01 is closed. PCA-02 is selected_not_started after fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
